description: This source file defines a generic class MemoryAdapterFactory<TSerializer> in the Orleans.Streaming.MemoryStreams namespace, which implements interfaces related to queue adapter factory, queue adapter, and cache. The class manages in-memory stream provider adapters, including buffer pools, queue mappings, and message batching for in-memory stream processing, primarily used for testing scenarios.

classes.name: MemoryAdapterFactory<TSerializer>
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing in-memory stream adapters for Orleans streaming provider, supporting queue creation, message batching, buffer pooling, and cache management.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new MemoryAdapterFactory<TSerializer> instance with dependencies resolved from the service provider.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes internal structures like queue grains and stream queue mapper.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns this in-memory adapter instance.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache interface for the adapter.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Provides the stream queue mapper used for mapping streams to queues.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver for a specified queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Serializes and enqueues a batch of messages for a stream and stream ID.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a cache for a specific queue ID, initializing buffer pools if necessary.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a failure handler for message delivery issues.

methods.name: GenerateDeterministicGuid
methods.description: Generates a consistent GUID based on queue ID and factory name hash.

methods.name: GetQueueGrain
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a grain managing a specific in-memory queue.

methods.name: LogErrorQueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during message batch enqueuing.
